author: Corridor Crew
description:
The Miniature Wife (2026) has some very well executed VFX that bring to life the illusion of miniature humans interacting with objects and full-sized people.

This train shot alone involved a motion control arm, a programmable mechanical-bull-like turntable rig, and collaboration between different VFX studios, all coordinated by VFX Supervisor Ashley Bernes.

Not bad at all for a TV series production!
title: How they shot a tiny wife on a moving train
